title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Installment Arrangements for Earlier-Year Balances
content:
A household whose earlier-school-year Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment still carries a balance may ask to settle it in installments. The family pays the first installment itself, through the district's online payment portal or at the campus cashier. The support desk quotes the amount and never takes card details. The payment posts to that earlier-year enrollment.

**Registration while a balance is being paid.** Registration is still not accepted while any of the household's Creek Kids Club enrollments from an earlier school year carries a balance above zero. The exception is an earlier-year enrollment on which the family has paid the first installment of an installment arrangement under this policy: it no longer blocks registration while the rest of its balance is being paid.

**When the first installment is fixed.** The first installment is not fixed until the enrollment's final billed month has been credited for the part of its tuition that the notice period does not reach.

## Invocation: `pay_prior_year_installment_d4311e53`

This is the family's own payment tool. The agent unlocks `pay_prior_year_installment_d4311e53` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, paying in person through the online payment portal or at the campus cashier. One run books one family payment on the earlier-year enrollment's billing history, dated the day it is made, and issues a confirmation number. That enrollment's balance due goes down by the amount paid.

- `care_enrollment_id`: the reference number of the earlier-year Extended Day enrollment the installment is for, as read out by the support desk from the Extended Day enrollment lookup. Identifier.
- `payment_amount`: the amount paid in US dollars. It is a positive amount with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, half a cent rounding up. Zero or negative amounts are not accepted.
- `payment_method`: one of `online_card` (debit or credit card through the online payment portal), `ach_bank_draft` (bank draft through the online payment portal), `personal_check` (personal check at the campus cashier) or `money_order` (money order at the campus cashier). `not_applicable` is never a family payment method, and a run carrying it is refused.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the payment's confirmation number (ten digits), the payment entry reference number (text beginning `cpi_`), the enrollment reference number, the amount paid in dollars with two decimals, the method and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). Its presence means the payment is booked. A sentence beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked. That happens for a method outside the four listed, for an amount that is not a positive amount with at most two decimal places, or when no Extended Day enrollment has the reference number given.

## Questions answered

**Does paying the first installment clear the registration block?** The earlier-year enrollment no longer blocks registration once the family has paid the first installment of the arrangement, while the rest of its balance is being paid.

**Which enrollment does the installment post to?** The earlier-year enrollment that carries the balance.
